response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine developer-tooling instincts (built a D test runner, assertion library, MCP code generators, and worked on the LabWindows/CVI C IDE at National Instruments), and he has a strong track record on complex distributed and high-throughput systems. However, the role's core requirements — deep JVM expertise, Kotlin, and the Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate enterprise ecosystem — are essentially absent. Java appears only as a secondary language in a 2016–2018 role, Kotlin and Spring are never mentioned, and the last decade of his work is centered on TypeScript/Node.js and D. The ramp-up on enterprise JVM frameworks and IDE internals for Java/Kotlin would be substantial, so he is not a fit for this specific mid-senior IC opening despite being a strong engineer overall.
strengths: Prior IDE/developer-tooling work (LabWindows/CVI, custom test runner, MCP generators)
Deep experience with complex, high-throughput and large-scale systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, teaching and workshop delivery
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience
Java exposure is peripheral and roughly a decade old; no deep JVM signal
Recent career centered on TypeScript/Node and D, not the JVM ecosystem
